_note: Niqab images, in the order they appear on the product page. Same studio look as the abayas and the hijab sample (Beaded Charcoal Black Net Hijab): faceless adult mannequin in a white shirt, then a close-up of the fabric.

hero-1.title: Three-quarter view
hero-1.prompt:
Use the attached product photo as the only reference for the niqab. Recreate this exact niqab without any change: the same colour and shade, fabric and weave, number of layers, length of each layer, shape and size of the eye opening, edge finish, ties or elastic, and every design detail exactly where it appears in the photo. Do not add any detail, decoration or element that is not in the photo, and do not remove, simplify or redesign anything that is. Copy exactly how the niqab is built at the top and sides: the band, ties or elastic that hold it on the head, and whether it has a separate piece over the forehead. Do not add a forehead band, cap, second strap or extra slit that the reference photo does not show. Keep the eye opening exactly the same shape and size: a narrow slit stays a narrow slit and a wide opening stays wide. Keep any charm, pendant or trim exactly where it is.

The reference photo may contain a brand logo, watermark, text or label, for example in a corner, across the image or printed on a tag. These are not part of the product. Do not copy them: remove them completely, recreate the fabric or background underneath as if they were never there, and do not add any other logo, text or watermark anywhere in the new image. Photorealistic luxury product photography, true-to-life colour, sharp focus on the niqab, natural fabric drape.

Shown on a life-size adult female display mannequin, the size of a grown woman (about 170 cm tall in full), seen from the waist up: a full adult torso with broad, softly rounded shoulders, a defined bust and waist, and an adult-sized head and neck in true proportion to the body, not a child or teenage mannequin. The mannequin is smooth matte warm-ivory with a completely featureless face, a blank egg shape with no eyes, nose or mouth. It wears a plain bright white long-sleeved shirt with a high round neckline, with no print, buttons, pockets or logo. On the head it wears a plain hijab in the same colour as the niqab (even if the reference photo shows a hijab in another colour), smooth fabric with no decoration, wrapped neatly to cover the top, back and sides of the head and the whole neck, falling over the shoulders.

The niqab is worn on top of the hijab, over the face, exactly as designed: tied or fastened at the back of the head over the hijab, its eye opening at eye level, covering the lower face and falling down over the chest as far as it does in the reference photo, with every layer visible. The hijab is always underneath and the niqab always on top; never put the hijab over the niqab. No jewellery, pins or other accessories.

Three-quarter view of the mannequin from the waist up, head turned slightly to one side, showing how the niqab's layers fall from the face over the chest and how it is tied at the side and back of the head over the hijab. Seamless warm ivory studio backdrop, soft diffused light. Vertical 4:5 image.
